#INPUT:

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
gc()

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(tibble)



# Load cleaned object

load("Visium_Pain_clean.RData")  # loads 'experiment'

experiment <- UpdateSeuratObject(experiment)
validObject(experiment)
```

```{r}
### BASIC METADATA CHECK

meta <- experiment@meta.data

meta_small <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(labels, condition, batch)


# Count spots per region / per region_condition / per region_batch / per region_batch_condition

spots_per_region <- meta_small %>%
  dplyr::count(labels, name = "n_spots_total") %>%
  arrange(labels)

head(spots_per_region)


spots_per_region_condition <- meta_small %>%
  dplyr::count(labels, condition, name = "n_spots") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = n_spots,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
   left_join(spots_per_region, by  = "labels") %>%
  arrange(labels)

head(spots_per_region_condition)


spots_per_region_batch <- meta_small %>%
  dplyr::count(labels, batch, name = "n_spots") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = batch,
    values_from = n_spots,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(spots_per_region, by  = "labels") %>%
  arrange(labels)

head(spots_per_region_batch)


spots_per_region_batch_condition <- meta_small %>%
  dplyr::count(labels, batch, condition, name = "n_spots") %>%
   left_join(spots_per_region, by  = "labels") %>%
  arrange(labels, batch, condition)

head(spots_per_region_batch_condition)

output_dir <- "01_1_counts spots"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(spots_per_region, file.path(output_dir,"spots_per_region.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(spots_per_region_condition, file.path(output_dir,"spots_per_region_condition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(spots_per_region_batch, file.path(output_dir,"spots_per_region_batch.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(spots_per_region_batch_condition, file.path(output_dir,"spots_per_region_batch_condition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

pal <- readRDS("region_palette_manual.rds")

pal

```{r}
### OVERVIEW FIGURE CONDITION / HISTO / ANNOTATION / LEGEND

image_names <- c("SNI1", "sham1", "SNI2", "sham2")

output_dir <- "01_2_histo_annotation_panels"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


plot_sample_name <- function(sample_name) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.5,
      label = sample_name,
      size = 4,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    xlim(0, 1) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_void()
}


plot_histology <- function(seurat_obj, image_name) {
  img <- seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@image

  ggplot() +
    annotation_raster(
      as.raster(img),
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    theme_void()
}


plot_annotation <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  image_name,
  show_legend = FALSE
) {
  cells_use <- rownames(
    seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@coordinates
  )

  obj_sub <- subset(
    seurat_obj,
    cells = cells_use
  )

  obj_sub@images <- obj_sub@images[image_name]

  p <- SpatialDimPlot(
    obj_sub,
    group.by = "labels",
    label = FALSE,
    cols = pal,
    image.alpha = 0,
    pt.size.factor = 2000,
    crop = FALSE
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank()
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + NoLegend()
  } else {
    p <- p +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
      )
  }

  p
}


# Generate panels

histo_plots <- setNames(
  lapply(
    image_names,
    function(img) {
      plot_histology(
        experiment,
        img
      )
    }
  ),
  image_names
)


annotation_plots <- setNames(
  lapply(
    image_names,
    function(img) {
      plot_annotation(
        experiment,
        img,
        show_legend = FALSE
      )
    }
  ),
  image_names
)


# Generate shared legend

legend_source <- plot_annotation(
  experiment,
  image_names[1],
  show_legend = TRUE
) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(ncol = 1),
    fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)
  )

legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(
  legend_source
)

legend_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw(
  legend_grob
)


# Save individual histology and annotation panels, and shared legend

for (img in image_names) {

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(img, "_histo.pdf")
    ),
    plot = histo_plots[[img]],
    width = 3,
    height = 3,
    units = "in",
    device = cairo_pdf
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(img, "_annotation.pdf")
    ),
    plot = annotation_plots[[img]],
    width = 3,
    height = 3,
    units = "in",
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
}


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "region_legend.pdf"
  ),
  plot = legend_plot,
  width = 1.8,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)


# Display and save composite figure

left_rows <- lapply(
  image_names,
  function(img) {
    plot_sample_name(img) +
      histo_plots[[img]] +
      annotation_plots[[img]] +
      plot_layout(
        widths = c(0.7, 1.5, 1.5)
      )
  }
)

left_panel <- wrap_plots(
  left_rows,
  ncol = 1
)

final_plot <- (
  left_panel |
    legend_plot
) +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 2,
    widths = c(5, 1.6)
  )

final_plot

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "histo_annotations_composite.pdf"
  ),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
### SUPPLEMENTARY QC TABLES

output_dir <- "01_5_supplementary tables"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)


sample_map <- bind_rows(
  lapply(image_names, function(img) {
    data.frame(
      barcode = Cells(experiment[[img]]),
      sample = img
    )
  })
)

meta_qc <- experiment@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("barcode") %>%
  left_join(sample_map, by = "barcode") %>%
  mutate(
    region = labels,
    sample = factor(sample, levels = c("sham1", "sham2", "SNI1", "SNI2")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("sham", "SNI"))
  )

spots_per_sample_region_long <- meta_qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(region)) %>%
  dplyr::count(region, sample, name = "n_spots") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    region,
    sample,
    fill = list(n_spots = 0)
  )


# 1. Spots per sample and region, wide format
spots_per_sample_region_wide <- spots_per_sample_region_long %>%
  dplyr::select(region, sample, n_spots) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample,
    values_from = n_spots,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_spots = sham1 + sham2 + SNI1 + SNI2,
    sham_total = sham1 + sham2,
    SNI_total = SNI1 + SNI2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(total_spots))

write.csv(
  spots_per_sample_region_wide,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S1_spots_per_sample_region_wide.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 2. Region coverage / balance table
region_coverage_flags <- spots_per_sample_region_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_samples_present =
      (sham1 > 0) +
      (sham2 > 0) +
      (SNI1 > 0) +
      (SNI2 > 0),

    min_spots_per_sample = pmin(sham1, sham2, SNI1, SNI2),

    qc_status = dplyr::case_when(
      n_samples_present < 4 ~ "incomplete",
      min_spots_per_sample >= 30 ~ "robust",
      min_spots_per_sample >= 10 ~ "reduced",
      TRUE ~ "low"
    ),

    qc_note = dplyr::case_when(
      qc_status == "robust" ~ "all samples represented; minimum spot count >= 30",
      qc_status == "reduced" ~ "all samples represented; one or more samples have 10-29 spots",
      qc_status == "low" ~ "all samples represented; one or more samples have <10 spots",
      qc_status == "incomplete" ~ "region missing in at least one sample"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    region,
    sham1,
    sham2,
    SNI1,
    SNI2,
    n_samples_present,
    min_spots_per_sample,
    qc_status,
    qc_note
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(qc_status, levels = c("robust", "reduced", "low", "incomplete")),
    min_spots_per_sample,
    region
  )

write.csv(
  region_coverage_flags,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S2_region_coverage_flags.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 3. Molecular QC per sample
molecular_qc_per_sample <- meta_qc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_spots = n(),
    median_nCount_Spatial = median(nCount_Spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nCount_Spatial = mean(nCount_Spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_nFeature_Spatial = median(nFeature_Spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_nFeature_Spatial = mean(nFeature_Spatial, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  molecular_qc_per_sample,
  file.path(output_dir,"Table_S3_molecular_qc_per_sample.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
